unlock.title: Unlocking DLCs
unlock.desc: When deploying a game, DLCs are already bundled. (Full DLC package is not guaranteed for all games).

missing.title: Standalone DLC Unlock
missing.desc: Settings -> Experimental -> DLC Manager can supplement standalone DLCs for your base games. (Some online-verified DLCs cannot be added).

safety.title: DLC Updates
safety.desc: If newly released DLCs cannot be found, please send us a message in the sidebar; we will update them promptly!

download.title: ASF Card Idler
download.desc: If you know, you know: idle cards for games on your main account, sell them on the Steam Market, and use the wallet balance to buy more games.

engine.title: Using Download Engine
engine.desc: Built-in aria2c core with 16-thread concurrency. Only supports HTTP links. Click + and paste the download link. Optimized for Nexus Mods direct links. Please configure download folder before use.

minigame.title: What Are Mini-Games For?
minigame.desc: Earn download quotas by playing original TC mini-games. As the creator masters more skills, the games will keep getting more fun!

errNodeFail.a: Check your network or switch nodes. If all nodes are down, maintenance may be in progress.

invalidEntry.a: Make sure you aren't running competing tools. Redeploy and restart Steam.

noInternet.a: Usually a local DNS or proxy conflict. Run Diagnostics in Settings to auto-fix.

gameWontStart.a: Games with 3rd-party launchers (EA, Ubisoft) or unpatched Denuvo require separate patches.

updateFail.a: Right-click the game in Digital Library and choose Update.

shop.story:
We built TC because as players, we were sick of broken releases and malware-laced patches.

Completely isolated, safe for your main account, with zero ads or bloatware. Try before you buy, decide where your money goes after you play.

All sponsorships fund node bandwidth and server upkeep. A cup of coffee keeps us alive—even if you stay free, enjoy your games tonight.
